records.issue_text: **C1. `PATCH /admin/groups/:id` silently no-ops membership changes and flips the group invisible** — `app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:34-47`
records.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#update`, the code now unconditionally does `group.visible = params[:visible] == "true"` and no longer branches for PATCH (`update_patch` was removed). A PATCH request that previously sent only membership `changes` (no `visible` param) will (1) have its membership changes ignored (no handling of `params[:changes]` / usernames in `update`) and (2) set `visible` to `false`

records.issue_text: `group.users.delete(user_id)` — `CollectionAssociation#delete` resolves integer args via `records = find(records)`, **scoped to the association**, so a non-member raises `ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound` → 404, not the `success_json` below it. Admin double-clicks the remove "×": first succeeds, second 404s. `Discourse.Group#removeMember` (`models/group.js:40-49`) has **no rejection handler**, so `findMembers()` never runs, the list never refreshes, and the admin sees nothing. The deleted spec `it "succeeds silently when removing non-members"` documented the old contract; the behavior changed with nothing replacing it. Fix: resolve the user explicitly and make removal idempotent; add a `.catch` client-side.
records.rationale: In the diff, `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member` does `group.users.delete(user_id)` with no rescue/guard for “user not in group”, so a repeated/duplicate remove (or stale UI) can raise and return an error instead of `success_json`. records.issue_text: **I4. `/groups/:name/members.json` accepts unbounded `limit` and negative `offset`** — `groups_controller.rb:22-26`
records.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and then uses `limit(limit).offset(offset)` without any bounds checking or clamping.
